system.description: Bands of Chaos Space Marines form around the strongest and most dangerous of their fellows. These Aspiring Champions adorn their armour with trophies from the slain and burn with ambition, aspiring to become Chaos Lords — or to be torn apart trying.

specialAbility.name: Inspiring Presence
specialAbility.effect: When an ally within sight of the Aspiring Champion uses an Infamy Point, as a Free Action the Aspiring Champion may choose to allow the ally to use his Infamy Point as if he possessed the Aspiring Champion's Corruption Point level and Alignment.

choices.label: Air of Authority or Disturbing Voice
Lesser Minion of Chaos or Sure Strike

system.description: The most experienced and dedicated Chaos Space Marines become the Chosen, favoured by the Ruinous Powers and harder-bitten than their brothers. They fight in the vanguard, where the glory and the spoils are greatest, and think nothing of spending their comrades' lives.

specialAbility.name: Cold Killer
specialAbility.effect: When a Chosen inflicts Zealous Hatred on a target, he may choose to reroll the Crit Result. The second result stands.

system.description: An outcast from his former allegiance, the Forsaken wanders alone and joins other warbands only out of necessity. He is well acquainted with the challenges of operating alone, chief among them the need for supplies.

specialAbility.name: Resourceful
specialAbility.effect: The Forsaken gains a +10 to his Infamy Test when obtaining an item or items with an Availability of Rare or lower.

system.description: A Chaos Space Marine who has mastered the art of the psyker. Where his brothers trust to bolter and blade, the Sorcerer bargains with the entities of the Immaterium — and pays their price.

specialAbility.name: Sorcerer
specialAbility.effect: The Heretic gains the Psyker Trait, a Psy Rating of 2, and 1 Corruption Point. When determining Psychic Strength (see p. 206), he counts as Bound.

system.description: An infiltrator and silver-tongued serpent, the Apostate turns crowds into congregations and congregations into unwitting servants of Chaos. Preachers, cardinals and traitorous adepts alike walk this path.

specialAbility.name: Serpent's Tongue
specialAbility.effect: Once per game session, the Apostate may make a Challenging Charm or Deceive Test to gain the Peer Talent with one organisation of his choice for the remainder of the session. If the Apostate has a Fellowship of 55 or higher, he can gain the Peer (2) Talent instead.

choices.label: Inspire Wrath, Iron Discipline or Lesser Minion of Chaos
Best-Craftsmanship Sword or Common Power Blade

system.description: One initiated into the mysteries of technology and turned rebel against the cult of the Adeptus Mechanicus. The Heretek fuses the power of the warp with technology forbidden to his former peers on pain of death.

specialAbility.name: Traitor to Mars
specialAbility.effect: The Heretek gains the Mechanicus Implants Trait, as well as two Good Craftsmanship cybernetics of his choice.

choices.label: Lesser Minion of Chaos (servitor or servo-skull) or Cold Hearted
Common Power Axe or Good Great Weapon (Greataxe)
Luminen Capacitors, Maglev Coils or Ferric Lure Implants

system.description: A soldier of the Imperium who turned his guns around. The Renegade survives on skill at arms rather than brute force, and may still be learning what his new allies really are.

specialAbility.name: Adroit
specialAbility.effect: The Renegade must select one Characteristic at character creation. Throughout the game he adds one additional Degree of Success to successful Tests involving that Characteristic (this includes Skill and Characteristic Tests).

choices.label: Sure Strike, Deadeye Shot or Marksman
Best Lasgun, Good Boltgun, Common Plasma Gun or Common Heavy Flamer
Best Laspistol or Common Bolt Pistol
Best Chainsword or Common Power Mace

system.description: An unsanctioned witch turned to Chaos, infused by the warp and answerable to no Black Ship. Such psykers rarely plan and rarely last, but while they burn they burn very brightly.

specialAbility.name: Chaos Psyker
specialAbility.effect: The Heretic is an unsanctioned psyker with access to the powers of the warp. He begins play with the Psyker Trait, a Psy Rating of 3, and 1d5 Corruption Points. When determining his Psychic Strength (see p. 206), he counts as Unbound.

choices.label: Weapon Training (Las, Solid Projectile or Shock)
Warp Sense or Child of the Warp
Common Laspistol or Common Stub Revolver
Good Sword or Common Neural Whip
